page.layout: One page of text, in one column, with a running head above and the page number at the top right. Top: a four-line italic verse stanza that ends the previous chapter, above a rule. Then a centred heading line, and below it the verse in stanzas. A gathering mark centred at the foot.

p.i: Ingens qua pelagus caeruleis fluctibus occulit. At seruit modò gentibus Vrbis progenies vicIa Syonia Quæ sæua superant Caucaseas barbarie feras.
LACTANS lingua tenellulis Sicca faucibus hæret Infantis, arens Quem sitis vrget.
Illum quum premeret fames, Frustulumque rogaret Panis, roganti Nemo tetendit.
Si quos mensa benignior Pauit, ecce per urbis Prostrauit illos Compita languor.
Si quos purpura nobiles Ante vestiit, atque Texere molli Stromata lecto.
Nudos quærere nunc fimum Dira cogit egestas Illicq;[?] fessa

page.notes: The four-line stanza at the top is partly cut off by the top edge; the lines are complete. The heading "VAV" is partly covered by an ink stain, so the last letters are doubtful. The gathering mark at the foot is a faint "C", possibly lowercase. The abbreviation in "Illicq;" is a superscript mark read as -que; it is doubtful. Printed spelling such as "vestiit" and "Pauit" is kept as printed.
